jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Patient Care Coordinator at Boutique Facial Plastic Surgery Practice - Denver, CO (Centennial/Greenwood Village/South DTC Area)

-- About Us --
An established, thriving
boutique cosmetic facial plastic surgery and aesthetics practice in the Centennial/Greenwood Village/South DTC area, with consistent growth and a strong reputation for exceptional outcomes and sophisticated patient experiences.

Led by a fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeon, we're at an exciting inflection point. We're in planning stages for a beautiful practice remodel
that will elevate our already-premium patient experience, and we're scaling strategically toward market leadership in Colorado cosmetic surgery and aesthetics.
This is the ideal time to join:
You'll be part of a proven, successful practice with momentum, not a risky startup. Your role will be instrumental in our next chapter of growth.

-- The Role --
This is fundamentally a high-stakes sales position
- but it's much more than that. You'll manage the complete patient journey from initial inquiry through consultation, treatment booking (surgical and non-surgical), and post-operative care, while also developing referral relationships and coordinating patient care.

You'll generate significant practice revenue through persistent prospect nurturing, sophisticated relationship-building, and strategic communication. You must also do whatever it takes (within ethical bounds) to ensure smooth patient care coordination. "That's not my job" isn't in your vocabulary.
Immediate Supervisor:
Chief Executive Officer and/or Director of Operations

-- What You'll Actually Do --
Sales & Prospect Development (65%)

Nurture prospect database through persistent, multi-touch outreach
Contact up to 100 patients daily without sacrificing quality or service
Convert prospects to consultations and consultations to booked treatment
Follow up over weeks (typically 8+ weeks, multiple weekly touchpoints via phone/email/text)
Navigate non-responsiveness, cancellations, anxiety, and complex decision-making
Reactivate dormant leads

Treatment Logistics (20%)

Schedule consultations, surgeries, treatments, and follow-ups
Coordinate pre-operative clearances, testing, hospital admissions, anesthesia/surgical tech coverage
Educate patients on procedures, recovery, financing
Ensure seamless patient experience from inquiry through recovery

Business Development & Referral Cultivation (10%)

Build business-to-business and physician-to-physician referral relationships
Represent practice at professional networking events
Maintain relationships with referral partners

Operations & Administration (5%)

Billing, monetary transactions, EMR/CRM systems
Answer calls, patient documentation, clinical room prep, photography
Train and mentor team members as practice grows
Assist with social media and marketing
Maintain luxury clinic appearance, open/close office as needed

-- Schedule & Availability --
Core:
Monday-Friday, 40-hour work week (generally 8 AM - 5 PM)
Required:
Occasional late afternoons/early evenings/early mornings (2-3/week) and weekends (couple times per year, may increase to once every 1-2 months as practice grows); available for time-sensitive calls/emails/text messages outside regular hours
Reality:
Our patients are busy professionals who often connect outside standard business hours. If you need strict 9-to-5 boundaries, this isn't the right fit.

-- Who We're Looking For --
Experience & Skills:
The ability to develop relationships, communicate exceptionally, exercise diplomacy, and positively influence others matters more than industry experience.
These talents are intrinsic while industry knowledge is learned.
Ideal backgrounds:

2-5+ years in high-touch sales, relationship management, or client coordination
Luxury hospitality, high-end retail, executive recruiting, real estate, professional speaking/training
Medical/aesthetic sales or patient coordination
What matters: demonstrated ability to build trust, influence decisions, and persistently convert difficult prospects

-- Key Traits We're Seeking --
Hunger to Succeed
As Mark Twain wrote: "Hunger is the handmaid of genius." You're motivated by achievement and results, not just a paycheck. You want compensation tied to performance.
Relentless Persistence
You maintain enthusiasm on the 8th, 9th, 10th follow-up attempt. Rejection energizes you to try different approaches. When prospects go silent, you see puzzles to solve, not dead leads.
Outstanding Communication & Influence
Exceptional written and verbal communication with impeccable grammar. You navigate nuanced conversations, overcome objections diplomatically, and build genuine trust quickly. You articulate complex medical concepts accessibly.
Openness to Learning
We have a very specific, proven process. You must be genuinely open to learning and following our established systems rather than relying solely on your own methods.
Proactive Problem-Solving
You anticipate needs without being told, find creative solutions, and take ownership of outcomes. "Whatever it takes within ethical bounds" describes your approach.
Professional Excellence & Team Mentality
Always punctual, polished appearance, extreme attention to detail, impeccable computer skills. Roll-up-your-sleeves, everybody-pitches-in approach with no-drama attitude. You represent a premium brand in everything you do.
Additional Essentials:
Energetic, self-motivated, thrives on multitasking, sophisticated interpersonal skills with high-expectation clientele, honest and consistent performance, handles pressure with grace.

-- What to Expect --
Our patients are successful, busy professionals
- which means they're sometimes hard to reach, thoughtful decision-makers, occasionally reschedule, and have high expectations.
You'll experience:

Building relationships with prospects over time through consistent, warm outreach
Creative problem-solving when busy executives are difficult to pin down
Celebrating wins when your persistence converts high-value patients
Fast-paced environment requiring sustained energy and focus

This is labor-intensive work demanding persistence and commitment to excellence.
But if you thrive on relationship-building, converting challenging prospects, and being rewarded for results, you'll love it here.

-- Compensation & Benefits --
Performance-Driven Earnings
Year 1:

Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to practice growth and individual metrics
Realistic total: $100,000-$125,000

Year 2-3 Growth Trajectory:
$120,000-$160,000+

Benefits:

Monthly benefits stipend (begins after probationary period)
Paid Time Off (company policy)
Special pricing (often complimentary) on aesthetic procedures for team members in good standing (begins after probationary period)
Professional development opportunities
Performance-based bonuses for exemplary results

-- Application Requirements --
To be considered, submit ALL of the following via [platform]:

Resume/CV

Cover letter
(your own original writing - no AI-generated content) addressing:

What specifically attracts you to this position?
How does this fit your long-term career objectives?
What qualities make you strong for this sales-based position?
How would previous employers/co-workers describe you?
Salary/wage requirements? (Be specific, not "negotiable")
Specific example of your persistence paying off with difficult client/customer

Important:
Attention to detail is essential in this role. Please demonstrate this by providing all requested items. Applications missing components will not be considered. All written communications must be your own work and not AI - we use AI verification tools to ensure authenticity of your communication abilities.

-- Interview Process --
Timeline:
1-3 weeks from application to offer
Process:
Initial interview (30-60 min) → In-person interview → Team meeting/practice tour → Working session with role-play and materials assessment → Reference checks
Background Check:
Comprehensive background and work verification by independent agency. Drug screening may be performed. Illicit drug use is disqualifying.

-- Essential Details --
Time divided between sitting, standing, walking
Polished, well-groomed professional appearance; uniform/professional attire as instructed
Strict HIPAA compliance required
Maintain OSHA standards and guidelines
Audio/video surveillance in workplace
High-performing, positive, collaborative team culture with appropriate professional boundaries

-- Equal Opportunity Employer --
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.
Ready to demonstrate what elite patient coordination and sales excellence look like? Apply now.

jobs.title: King's Trust Assistant Team Leader
jobs.description:
Make a Meaningful Impact Behind the Scenes at Capital City College

Are you ready to make an impact at one of London’s leading Further Education providers? Capital City College is looking for a skilled Kings Trust Assistant Team Leader to support and drive key operational functions, helping shape the future of education in the heart of London.

About The Role

This role is offered on a fixed-term, full-time basis, the contract will end on 31st of July 2027. This role is full-time, working 35 hours per week.

The Assistant Team Leader supports the successful delivery of The King’s Trust Team Programme at Capital City College, helping young people aged 16–25 to build confidence, motivation and skills to progress into employment, education, training or volunteering. Working closely with the Team Leader, the postholder contributes to the recruitment, planning, delivery and evaluation of the 12-week programme, while providing pastoral support and encouragement to participants.

About The Team

You will join a friendly, professional team committed to delivering high-quality support across the college. Working together, you’ll help create a positive and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued.

You will be joining a dynamic and supportive team of colleagues.who are committed to excellence. The team has a strong collaborative culture, sharing best practice and innovative approaches.

About You

We’re looking for a reliable and motivated individual who takes pride in delivering excellent service. You should bring:

Assist the Team Leader in developing and delivering a recruitment strategy to attract a diverse group of young people (16–25).Liaise with referral partners including Job Centres, Connexions, youth services, schools, employers and community organisations.Assist in delivering The King’s Trust Employment, Teamwork and Community Skills (ETCS) qualification from Entry Level 3 to Level 2.Support the organisation of purposeful enrichment activities such as guest speakers, day visits and residential experiences.Identify and report additional needs (e.g. literacy, numeracy, digital skills, or pastoral support) and contribute to individual learning plans.Support the facilitation of learner reviews, evaluations and assessments to monitor progress and encourage achievement.Assist with administrative duties including 1:1s, target setting, tracking portfolio progress and gathering assessment evidence.Contribute to the completion of reports and statistical returns for Capital City College and The King’s Trust.Participate in placement visits to ensure health, safety, and quality of experience.Help coordinate guest speakers and employer engagement to broaden learners’ opportunities.

About Us

Capital City College (CCC),one of the UK’s largest FE colleges in London. This influential group supports over35,000 studentsbased across 12 London campusesannually to develop the skills and knowledge to advance their career prospects or progress into higher education. This is done by an unrelenting commitment to curriculum innovation and an obsession with the quality of the student experience, which is underpinned by a resilient and prudent approach to financial management. Capital City College are widely recognised for their commitment to diversity, inclusivity, and educational excellence, positively impacting the lives of students across the capital and beyond.

Why Join Capital City College?

Benefits

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a passionate, purpose-driven team that puts learners first. At CCC, we value the dedication of our staff and offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

Membership of the Local Government Pension SchemeAccess to TELLUS – our discount and wellbeing platformParticipation in the Cycle to Work schemeInterest-free season ticket loans for public transportAnnual eye tests and contributions towards spectaclesFlu vaccinations and access to occupational health servicesMedicash health plans – including cashback on everyday medical expenses and wellbeing tools for you and your familyGenerous annual leave entitlement, including one Relaxation Day per yearFive Continuous Professional Development (CPD) days which can be used for your professional developmentOur Commitment to Equality and Safeguarding

We are proud to be a diverse and inclusive organisation. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are committed to creating a safe and respectful working environment for everyone.

CCC is committed to the safeguarding of young people and vulnerable adults. All roles require the successful candidate to undergo a DBS check — with some positions requiring an Enhanced Disclosure.

Our Values

To create a future that’s uniquely yours.

As the largest further and higher education college in London, we offer the quality you deserve, state of the art facilities and a wide range of courses as unique as your interests and aptitude. Through partnerships with industry and academia, we open doors to your real-world success.

Studying at our campuses isn’t just about good grades. It’s being part of a community within a community, that reflects the diversity and vibrancy of London itself. Where every background and perspective are celebrated, and everyone feels they belong.

As teachers and staff, we’re all driven by you –getting to know you, helping you feel valued and giving you hands-on support every step of the way. Whether you’re a creative spirit, a tech whiz, or a business mastermind, together we’ll create a future that’s uniquely yours.

Real-life learning

Practical and personal, we provide valuable skills and knowledge that you can apply in the real world.

Connected community

Welcoming and open-minded, we create a community of people and businesses where you feel valued, supported, and confident to grow.

Expanded horizons

Innovating and inspiring, we help you become and achieve more than you thought was possible.

Apply now for the Kings Trust Assistant Team Leader role if you're ready to contribute to the success of a dynamic education environment and make a real difference.

The Victorian Aboriginal Child and Community Agency (VACCA) is an Aboriginal Community-Controlled organisation that supports and advocates for the Aboriginal Community and is the largest organisation of its kind in Australia. Our strength lies with our people.

Lead a passionate team dedicated to strengthening the cultural identity, safety and connection of Aboriginal children and young people. Working alongside community, ACCOs, ACCHOs, DFFH and key partners, you will help create positive outcomes and support Aboriginal children and young people to stay connected to culture, family and Country.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

After Hours Program Supervisor

Requirements

ENVIROS - Who We Are:

Enviros

is an innovative social services agency that provides critical, individualized programs to children, youth, adults and families in vulnerable situations to meet their desired outcomes and wellness.

Enviros

helps our clients make strength-based changes to move to independence within a healthy community.

Enviros

focuses programs on the unique needs of individual clients practicing experiential learning to provide opportunities for personal discovery and growth.

Enviros

focus is on building relationships and is the foundation of the work we do. This enables clients to develop skills, healthy trust, and independence.

Since our founding in 1976,Enviros has been an early adopter of new evidence-based best practices and has developed and informed other leading practices.

Why People Choose Enviros

Simply stated, our vision is: “The Power of Human Relationships Invites Belonging and Inspires Growth”.

The Programs- Connects/Passages/Journeys/Triveri House/Excel

Enviros provides Group Care, Open custody, and Housing services in 5 live-in programs in Calgary with 24/7 supports. Group care programs (Connects, Passages and Journeys) provide support services to children and youth who, for a number of reasons, are unable to live at home and who are involved in Children and Family Services. Excel is an Open Custody program that supports young people in an open custody sentence who are exiting the justice system and reintegrating back into community. Triveri House is a placed based Supportive Housing program for young adults experiencing episodic or chronic homelessness.

The Position- After Hours Supervisor

The After Hours Supervisor is part of the Enviros Leadership team and is responsible for supporting the overall safety of person served and staff in the program while on shift. They are responsible for overseeing and coordinating the weekend overnight and on-call operations of the live-in programs and to promote and build relationships with other professionals. This full-time position will cover the Enviros Live-In Programs On-Call responsibilities Friday through Monday. This coordinator position involves a combination of administrative, training and direct client and staff support roles. This includes administrative responsibilities Mondays and Fridays along with direct support to Awake Overnight teams over the weekend (both over the phone and in person).

This role involves close communication with all live-in programs, program supervisors and managers. The position will include the coordination of awake overnight staff positions and scheduling relief coverage as required on weekends; this may include working an overnight shift when coverage cannot be obtained. Weekly work schedule will be flexible to accommodate on-all responsibilities.

Enviros Leadership Team

Actively support and participate in Enviros business plan activities
Attend monthly leadership meetings

Organization and Administration

Work closely with the live in program supervisors and managers to ensure all awake overnight shifts are covered
Support on-boarding and orientation training for new employees; particularly, the awake overnight teams and relief employees
Have a good understanding of and ensure all notifications are made according to Alberta Children’s’ Services and Alberta Solicitor General protocols and that internal communications with supervisors and managers follow Enviros policies
Provide crisis intervention and support

Reporting Relationship

Reports to the Live-In Program Manager

For Consideration Applicants Will Need to Demonstrate the Following

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants should have minimally a degree/diploma in the Human Service field, experience with youth in a group living environment; be aware of trauma informed practices, and be professional, reliable, and able to work independently.

A current criminal record check including vulnerable sector (completed within last 6 months).
A current Alberta Intervention Record check (completed within last 6 months).
Valid First Aid and CPR.
A valid class 5 driver’s license.
Current Suicide Intervention (ASSIST) and Therapeutic Crisis Intervention (TCI) training would be an asset and must be completed within 6 months of employment.

This position is well suited for individuals who are highly organized, excel in communication, have strong computer skills and can work calmly in urgent situations. The majority of this work will include coaching (through telephone or directly) front line awake overnight staff in dealing with situations involving person served. This roll also includes shift coverage and requires someone with strong interpersonal skills.

The successful candidate will have a high level of awareness regarding policy and protocols and will be able to apply critical thinking when dealing with urgent situations that arise.

Individuals who have experience working with Individuals in the vulnerable sector in a supervisory role, working in crisis situations and those with current Therapeutic Crisis Intervention training would be an asset.

All candidates are required to obtain the following training and documentation prior to starting this role:

A current Alberta Intervention Record check (completed within the last 12 months)
A current First Aid and CPR/AED ‘C’ certificate
A Class 4 or 5 Driver’s License (Class 5 GDL will not be accepted)
A 5 year drivers abstract with no major violations

Enviros believes in the power of diversity and we are dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and encourage people of all visible minorities, including Indigenous applicants, and those of any religion, sex, age, ability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression to apply.

Additionally, Enviros is committed to having a workforce of skilled and diversified representation of the population we serve. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply, however in our commitment to the population we serve, preference will be given to candidates self-identifying as an Indigenous Person.

Pre-Employment Background Check Requirements

As a condition of employment, all staff working for Enviros
are required to complete:

Both checks must be completed prior to the employee’s start date
. Please note that this process can take up to six (6) weeks
to complete.

Enviros will accept IRCs and Criminal Record Checks with VSC that are no more than six (6) months old
at the time of hire.

by clicking the links below and following the required process to avoid potential delays in commencement if you are the successful candidate. Please be aware that initiating these checks does not guarantee advancement

new_jobs.description:
Patient Care Coordinator at Boutique Facial Plastic Surgery Practice - Denver, CO (Centennial/Greenwood Village/South DTC Area)

-- About Us --
An established, thriving
boutique cosmetic facial plastic surgery and aesthetics practice in the Centennial/Greenwood Village/South DTC area, with consistent growth and a strong reputation for exceptional outcomes and sophisticated patient experiences.

Led by a fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeon, we're at an exciting inflection point. We're in planning stages for a beautiful practice remodel
that will elevate our already-premium patient experience, and we're scaling strategically toward market leadership in Colorado cosmetic surgery and aesthetics.
This is the ideal time to join:
You'll be part of a proven, successful practice with momentum, not a risky startup. Your role will be instrumental in our next chapter of growth.

-- The Role --
This is fundamentally a high-stakes sales position
- but it's much more than that. You'll manage the complete patient journey from initial inquiry through consultation, treatment booking (surgical and non-surgical), and post-operative care, while also developing referral relationships and coordinating patient care.

You'll generate significant practice revenue through persistent prospect nurturing, sophisticated relationship-building, and strategic communication. You must also do whatever it takes (within ethical bounds) to ensure smooth patient care coordination. "That's not my job" isn't in your vocabulary.
Immediate Supervisor:
Chief Executive Officer and/or Director of Operations

-- What You'll Actually Do --
Sales & Prospect Development (65%)

Nurture prospect database through persistent, multi-touch outreach
Contact up to 100 patients daily without sacrificing quality or service
Convert prospects to consultations and consultations to booked treatment
Follow up over weeks (typically 8+ weeks, multiple weekly touchpoints via phone/email/text)
Navigate non-responsiveness, cancellations, anxiety, and complex decision-making
Reactivate dormant leads

Treatment Logistics (20%)

Schedule consultations, surgeries, treatments, and follow-ups
Coordinate pre-operative clearances, testing, hospital admissions, anesthesia/surgical tech coverage
Educate patients on procedures, recovery, financing
Ensure seamless patient experience from inquiry through recovery

Business Development & Referral Cultivation (10%)

Build business-to-business and physician-to-physician referral relationships
Represent practice at professional networking events
Maintain relationships with referral partners

Operations & Administration (5%)

Billing, monetary transactions, EMR/CRM systems
Answer calls, patient documentation, clinical room prep, photography
Train and mentor team members as practice grows
Assist with social media and marketing
Maintain luxury clinic appearance, open/close office as needed

-- Schedule & Availability --
Core:
Monday-Friday, 40-hour work week (generally 8 AM - 5 PM)
Required:
Occasional late afternoons/early evenings/early mornings (2-3/week) and weekends (couple times per year, may increase to once every 1-2 months as practice grows); available for time-sensitive calls/emails/text messages outside regular hours
Reality:
Our patients are busy professionals who often connect outside standard business hours. If you need strict 9-to-5 boundaries, this isn't the right fit.

-- Who We're Looking For --
Experience & Skills:
The ability to develop relationships, communicate exceptionally, exercise diplomacy, and positively influence others matters more than industry experience.
These talents are intrinsic while industry knowledge is learned.
Ideal backgrounds:

2-5+ years in high-touch sales, relationship management, or client coordination
Luxury hospitality, high-end retail, executive recruiting, real estate, professional speaking/training
Medical/aesthetic sales or patient coordination
What matters: demonstrated ability to build trust, influence decisions, and persistently convert difficult prospects

-- Key Traits We're Seeking --
Hunger to Succeed
As Mark Twain wrote: "Hunger is the handmaid of genius." You're motivated by achievement and results, not just a paycheck. You want compensation tied to performance.
Relentless Persistence
You maintain enthusiasm on the 8th, 9th, 10th follow-up attempt. Rejection energizes you to try different approaches. When prospects go silent, you see puzzles to solve, not dead leads.
Outstanding Communication & Influence
Exceptional written and verbal communication with impeccable grammar. You navigate nuanced conversations, overcome objections diplomatically, and build genuine trust quickly. You articulate complex medical concepts accessibly.
Openness to Learning
We have a very specific, proven process. You must be genuinely open to learning and following our established systems rather than relying solely on your own methods.
Proactive Problem-Solving
You anticipate needs without being told, find creative solutions, and take ownership of outcomes. "Whatever it takes within ethical bounds" describes your approach.
Professional Excellence & Team Mentality
Always punctual, polished appearance, extreme attention to detail, impeccable computer skills. Roll-up-your-sleeves, everybody-pitches-in approach with no-drama attitude. You represent a premium brand in everything you do.
Additional Essentials:
Energetic, self-motivated, thrives on multitasking, sophisticated interpersonal skills with high-expectation clientele, honest and consistent performance, handles pressure with grace.

-- What to Expect --
Our patients are successful, busy professionals
- which means they're sometimes hard to reach, thoughtful decision-makers, occasionally reschedule, and have high expectations.
You'll experience:

Building relationships with prospects over time through consistent, warm outreach
Creative problem-solving when busy executives are difficult to pin down
Celebrating wins when your persistence converts high-value patients
Fast-paced environment requiring sustained energy and focus

This is labor-intensive work demanding persistence and commitment to excellence.
But if you thrive on relationship-building, converting challenging prospects, and being rewarded for results, you'll love it here.

-- Compensation & Benefits --
Performance-Driven Earnings
Year 1:

Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to practice growth and individual metrics
Realistic total: $100,000-$125,000

Year 2-3 Growth Trajectory:
$120,000-$160,000+

Benefits:

Monthly benefits stipend (begins after probationary period)
Paid Time Off (company policy)
Special pricing (often complimentary) on aesthetic procedures for team members in good standing (begins after probationary period)
Professional development opportunities
Performance-based bonuses for exemplary results

-- Application Requirements --
To be considered, submit ALL of the following via [platform]:

Resume/CV

Cover letter
(your own original writing - no AI-generated content) addressing:

What specifically attracts you to this position?
How does this fit your long-term career objectives?
What qualities make you strong for this sales-based position?
How would previous employers/co-workers describe you?
Salary/wage requirements? (Be specific, not "negotiable")
Specific example of your persistence paying off with difficult client/customer

Important:
Attention to detail is essential in this role. Please demonstrate this by providing all requested items. Applications missing components will not be considered. All written communications must be your own work and not AI - we use AI verification tools to ensure authenticity of your communication abilities.

-- Interview Process --
Timeline:
1-3 weeks from application to offer
Process:
Initial interview (30-60 min) → In-person interview → Team meeting/practice tour → Working session with role-play and materials assessment → Reference checks
Background Check:
Comprehensive background and work verification by independent agency. Drug screening may be performed. Illicit drug use is disqualifying.

-- Essential Details --
Time divided between sitting, standing, walking
Polished, well-groomed professional appearance; uniform/professional attire as instructed
Strict HIPAA compliance required
Maintain OSHA standards and guidelines
Audio/video surveillance in workplace
High-performing, positive, collaborative team culture with appropriate professional boundaries

-- Equal Opportunity Employer --
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.
Ready to demonstrate what elite patient coordination and sales excellence look like? Apply now.

new_jobs.title: After Hours Program Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
Brief Description

After Hours Program Supervisor

Requirements

ENVIROS - Who We Are:

Enviros

is an innovative social services agency that provides critical, individualized programs to children, youth, adults and families in vulnerable situations to meet their desired outcomes and wellness.

Enviros

helps our clients make strength-based changes to move to independence within a healthy community.

Enviros

focuses programs on the unique needs of individual clients practicing experiential learning to provide opportunities for personal discovery and growth.

Enviros

focus is on building relationships and is the foundation of the work we do. This enables clients to develop skills, healthy trust, and independence.

Since our founding in 1976,Enviros has been an early adopter of new evidence-based best practices and has developed and informed other leading practices.

Why People Choose Enviros

Simply stated, our vision is: “The Power of Human Relationships Invites Belonging and Inspires Growth”.

The Programs- Connects/Passages/Journeys/Triveri House/Excel

Enviros provides Group Care, Open custody, and Housing services in 5 live-in programs in Calgary with 24/7 supports. Group care programs (Connects, Passages and Journeys) provide support services to children and youth who, for a number of reasons, are unable to live at home and who are involved in Children and Family Services. Excel is an Open Custody program that supports young people in an open custody sentence who are exiting the justice system and reintegrating back into community. Triveri House is a placed based Supportive Housing program for young adults experiencing episodic or chronic homelessness.

The Position- After Hours Supervisor

The After Hours Supervisor is part of the Enviros Leadership team and is responsible for supporting the overall safety of person served and staff in the program while on shift. They are responsible for overseeing and coordinating the weekend overnight and on-call operations of the live-in programs and to promote and build relationships with other professionals. This full-time position will cover the Enviros Live-In Programs On-Call responsibilities Friday through Monday. This coordinator position involves a combination of administrative, training and direct client and staff support roles. This includes administrative responsibilities Mondays and Fridays along with direct support to Awake Overnight teams over the weekend (both over the phone and in person).

This role involves close communication with all live-in programs, program supervisors and managers. The position will include the coordination of awake overnight staff positions and scheduling relief coverage as required on weekends; this may include working an overnight shift when coverage cannot be obtained. Weekly work schedule will be flexible to accommodate on-all responsibilities.

Enviros Leadership Team

Actively support and participate in Enviros business plan activities
Attend monthly leadership meetings

Organization and Administration

Work closely with the live in program supervisors and managers to ensure all awake overnight shifts are covered
Support on-boarding and orientation training for new employees; particularly, the awake overnight teams and relief employees
Have a good understanding of and ensure all notifications are made according to Alberta Children’s’ Services and Alberta Solicitor General protocols and that internal communications with supervisors and managers follow Enviros policies
Provide crisis intervention and support

Reporting Relationship

Reports to the Live-In Program Manager

For Consideration Applicants Will Need to Demonstrate the Following

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants should have minimally a degree/diploma in the Human Service field, experience with youth in a group living environment; be aware of trauma informed practices, and be professional, reliable, and able to work independently.

A current criminal record check including vulnerable sector (completed within last 6 months).
A current Alberta Intervention Record check (completed within last 6 months).
Valid First Aid and CPR.
A valid class 5 driver’s license.
Current Suicide Intervention (ASSIST) and Therapeutic Crisis Intervention (TCI) training would be an asset and must be completed within 6 months of employment.

This position is well suited for individuals who are highly organized, excel in communication, have strong computer skills and can work calmly in urgent situations. The majority of this work will include coaching (through telephone or directly) front line awake overnight staff in dealing with situations involving person served. This roll also includes shift coverage and requires someone with strong interpersonal skills.

The successful candidate will have a high level of awareness regarding policy and protocols and will be able to apply critical thinking when dealing with urgent situations that arise.

Individuals who have experience working with Individuals in the vulnerable sector in a supervisory role, working in crisis situations and those with current Therapeutic Crisis Intervention training would be an asset.

All candidates are required to obtain the following training and documentation prior to starting this role:

A current Alberta Intervention Record check (completed within the last 12 months)
A current First Aid and CPR/AED ‘C’ certificate
A Class 4 or 5 Driver’s License (Class 5 GDL will not be accepted)
A 5 year drivers abstract with no major violations

Enviros believes in the power of diversity and we are dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and encourage people of all visible minorities, including Indigenous applicants, and those of any religion, sex, age, ability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression to apply.

Additionally, Enviros is committed to having a workforce of skilled and diversified representation of the population we serve. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply, however in our commitment to the population we serve, preference will be given to candidates self-identifying as an Indigenous Person.

are required to complete:

. Please note that this process can take up to six (6) weeks
to complete.

at the time of hire.
